fields.summary: Return 404 when the invoice id is unknown

content.text: GET /invoices/:id currently throws a 500 when the id does not exist, because getInvoice() dereferences a null row in src/billing/invoices.ts. Clients retry on 500, which floods the API. This sample issue is hand-written for Groundwork's tests.
Expected: 404 with error code INVOICE_NOT_FOUND. Actual: 500.
A test in src/billing/invoices.test.ts covers it
